verdict.rationale: Pilot is a managed bookkeeping service, so an API for drafting and posting journal entries is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack shows a public API, programmatic journal-entry posting, or a review queue for agent-drafted entries. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the only workflow evidence is human accountants working through the portal.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
